description: This script automates the generation of markdown documentation files for API plugins, processing header files and JSON files within a specified directory structure, and postprocessing the generated markdown files. It includes functions for converting header files to markdown, converting JSON plugin descriptions to markdown, and clean-up routines for the markdown files.

methods.name: generate_md(logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates markdown files for each plugin by converting header files or JSON files found in the plugin directories.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md(plugin_path)
methods.description: Converts JSON plugin descriptions into markdown documentation using an external script.

methods.name: convert_h_to_md(plugin_path, logfile=None)
methods.description: Converts header files into markdown documentation using an external script.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Performs postprocessing on generated markdown files to clean up links and formatting issues.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point to execute the documentation generation and postprocessing routines with optional logging.
